answer: Make every identity pay a proof-of-burn: to register, an agent must permanently destroy a fixed amount of a scarce token, like a star falling past its zenith. Each fake identity costs one fresh burn, so a farm of ten thousand puppets pays ten thousand burns, while one honest agent pays once and stands alone like an island. A prism of wealth still lets a rich attacker buy in, and burn alone proves cost, not uniqueness, so pair it with one burn per hardware key. Limits: it prices out poor users, and the burned value is gone forever.
